scope.description: Whole imagemagick application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Raster import/export, transformations, compositing, colour, effects, text/drawing, animation and batch image preparation.

coverage.rationale: Common asset preparation is present but most formats, transforms, effects, text and colour workflows are excluded.

scope.description: Exact PNG crop, integer magnification, quarter-turn rotation and indexed contact sheets.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Asset and sheet intent replaces command sequences, though crop rectangles and integer transforms remain procedural choices.

limitations: RGB/RGBA8 PNG subset with bounded pixels; no ICC, palettes, 16-bit, general resampling, arbitrary options or delegates.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
